<｜｜DSML｜｜ parameter name="query" string="true">import sqlite3, os, json

p = "./abb-tablegpt-0bueqplp/profile/history.sqlite"
print("size:", os.path.getsize(p))
con = sqlite3.connect(p)
tabs = con.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'").fetchall()
print("tables:", tabs)
for (t,) in tabs:
    try:
        rows = con.execute(f"SELECT * FROM {t} LIMIT 3").fetchall()
        cols = [d[0] for d in con.execute(f"SELECT * FROM {t} LIMIT 1").description]
        print(f"\n{t} cols: {cols}\n sample: {str(rows)[:600]}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(t, "err", e)
